relationships.subject: TRPV1-lineage fibers
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that optical excitation of TRPV1-lineage fibers elicited responses in traditionally defined taste neurons in lateral PB nuclei.

relationships.subject: TRPV1-lineage fibers
relationships.evidence_quote: neurons responsive to photostimulation of TRPV1-lineage afferents showed strong responses to temperature including noxious heat, which predominantly excited PB bitter taste cells

key_findings: Optogenetic excitation of TRPV1-lineage trigeminal fibers drives responses in parabrachial taste neurons in mice.
PB neurons responsive to TRPV1-lineage input respond strongly to noxious heat and aversive tastes, encoding shared sensory valence.
